mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_file WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM kb_file WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND (is_current = 1 OR is_current IS NULL) ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT * FROM kb_file WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND file_name = #{fileName} AND (is_current = 1 OR is_current IS NULL) ORDER BY version_no DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT 1

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_file (kb_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, file_path, version_no, version_group_id, parent_version_id, file_sha256, folder_id, category, is_current, quality_status, quality_score, vector_status, image_context, status, process_stage, progress, error_message, process_attempts, next_retry_time, create_time) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{filePath}, #{versionNo}, #{versionGroupId}, #{parentVersionId}, #{fileSha256}, #{folderId}, #{category}, #{isCurrent}, #{qualityStatus}, #{qualityScore}, #{vectorStatus}, #{imageContext}, #{status}, #{processStage}, #{progress}, #{errorMessage}, #{processAttempts}, #{nextRetryTime}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_file SET version_group_id = #{versionGroupId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE kb_file SET is_current = CASE WHEN id = #{id} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE version_group_id = #{versionGroupId}
UPDATE kb_file SET is_current = 0 WHERE version_group_id = #{versionGroupId}
UPDATE kb_file SET folder_id = #{folderId}, category = #{category} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE kb_file SET quality_status = #{qualityStatus}, quality_score = #{qualityScore}, vector_status = #{vectorStatus} WHERE id = #{id}
